body.name: two-split moment estimators
body.construction: On observations \(1,\ldots,n_{\rm tr}\), compute \(\widehat G_X^{\rm tr}=n_{\rm tr}^{-1}\sum_i u(X_i)u(X_i)^\top\), \(\widehat B^{\rm tr}=n_{\rm tr}^{-1}\sum_i u(X_i)v(W_i)^\top\), and \(\widehat W_X^{\rm tr}=\Pi_{[\eta/2,2/\eta]}(\widehat G_X^{\rm tr})^{-1/2}\). On observations \(n_{\rm tr}+1,\ldots,n\), compute \(\widehat m^{\rm te}=n_{\rm te}^{-1}\sum_i u(X_i)Y_i\). Set \(\widehat A^{\rm tr}=\widehat W_X^{\rm tr}\widehat B^{\rm tr}\) and \(\widehat b^{\rm te}=\widehat W_X^{\rm tr}\widehat m^{\rm te}\).
